name: afc-avatar-pack-svg-v3-epic
description: EPIC enhanced SVG layered avatar pack for Atomic Fizz Caps Vault 77. Detailed wasteland aesthetic with authentic Fallout styling, anatomically accurate features, and immersive post-apocalyptic details.
theme: Post-apocalyptic Fallout-style wasteland survivor - EPIC edition

changes: Dramatically enhanced all 77 SVG assets with detailed gradients and shading
Added anatomically accurate facial features with proper depth and dimension
Implemented realistic skin tones with multiple gradient layers
Enhanced eyes with iris detail, catchlights, and realistic eyelids
Upgraded Vault suit with proper seams, zippers, pockets, and Vault 77 badge
Detailed mohawk with individual hair spikes and texture
Realistic claw scars with tissue damage, healing patterns, and depth
Authentic bullet wound with crater, scar tissue, and powder burns
Epic armor with metal plates, rivets, weathering, and battle damage
Detailed goggles with lens reflections, scratches, and leather straps
Enhanced beard with hair texture, depth, and wasteland aging
Realistic radiation burns with tissue damage and mottled skin
Cybernetic eye with LED glow, targeting reticle, and mechanical detail
Added weathering, scratches, and wasteland survivor details throughout
Maintained performance: all assets under 5KB, total ~340KB
v3.0.0.impact: Transforms character system from basic to EPIC - immersive and authentic Fallout aesthetic

styleGuide.palette: Earthy, muted wasteland colors with enhanced depth
styleGuide.lineStyle: Detailed paths with anatomical accuracy and realistic textures
styleGuide.shading: Multi-layer gradients for depth, highlights, and shadows
styleGuide.weathering: Battle scars, rust, scratches, and post-apocalyptic wear
styleGuide.fileSize: Optimized for web performance (average 3-4KB per asset)
styleGuide.aesthetic: Fallout-inspired wasteland survivor - stylized but realistic

usage.compositing: Layer SVGs in order specified by layerOrder array
usage.colorization: Apply fill/stroke colors via CSS or inline styles
usage.integration: Works seamlessly with existing character-creator.js system

license: CC0 or original - created for Atomic Fizz Caps Vault 77 project
notes: EPIC v3.0 release: Complete asset library overhaul for wasteland survivor character creation. All SVGs feature detailed shading, anatomical accuracy, and authentic Fallout aesthetic. Includes race-specific options (ghoul burns, synth circuitry, vault tattoos) with realistic detail. Perfect for immersive wasteland gameplay without breaking the fourth wall.
